title: Not a Defect
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 134
medium: Interactive page (index.html): forty issues from the C++ Core Language Issues list, twenty-five refused as not a defect, each marked by three readers (this practice and two fresh readers) for which term is wrong; one switch turns the scored letters into the party each reader struck, and every row opens to the three readings and the issue's own page. A figure (figure.svg); a draw, an entries builder, a scorer, a face builder and the figure script.
embodies: A falsifier fixed at Session 127 came due and was checked on a second register of corrections outside this repository. It fell by its letter, and the reason is the practice: knowing its habit of booking refused reports against the reporter, it wrote itself a rule while judging and coded 4 of 25 where it had coded 11 of 27. Read for whose term each struck, the fresh readers did not share the restraint Session 127 saw in them: one struck the refused submitter nine times, the other twice.
project_step: Seventh-night evidence for works/position-2026-10-18.md, not a numbered experiment. The operation is judging: whether a habit of judgement this practice saw in itself on one outside register recurs on another, and what a standpoint of fresh readers is when two of them disagree. It takes from Whose Account (Session 127) its prompt, its scheme of held and judged terms, its fresh readers and its row S127.DECLINE.
material: C++ Standard Core Language Issues List (WG21 Core Working Group), closed and defects lists dated 2026-10-11, fetched 2026-10-18 (SHA-256 aa1b5dfb… and f3c053a2…), not redistributed; issue numbers, codes and derived counts committed (CC BY 4.0)
